title: blob.rs BlobUploadResponse.sha256: Option<String> — consider validated newtype
description: BlobUploadResponse::sha256 is Option<String> where the expected invariant is 64-char lowercase hex. The format is validated lazily in upload_blob via validate_sha256_format(), but callers who hold a BlobUploadResponse cannot tell from the type whether the sha256 has been validated. A SHA256Hex newtype (or even a [u8; 32]) would make the validated state unrepresentable as an unvalidated String and eliminate the need for downstream callers to re-validate.
